## Remote Team Meeting Plan for 2026-02-12

A concise 90-minute agenda that works across London and Nairobi, with a balanced discussion split and a built-in closing buffer.

## Agenda, Time Split, and Invite Copy

| Segment | Duration | Focus | Lead |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Welcome and goals | 10 min | Confirm outcomes, agenda, and decision points | Host |
| Team updates | 20 min | Quick status round from all 8 participants | All |
| Core discussion 1 | 25 min | Main topic A: blockers, priorities, or decisions | Topic owner |
| Core discussion 2 | 20 min | Main topic B: alignment, planning, or review | Topic owner |
| Decisions and actions | 15 min | Assign owners, deadlines, and next steps | Host |
| Buffer and wrap-up | 10 min | Questions, overruns, timezone-friendly close | Host |

### Fair discussion split
- **London and Nairobi are both fully within business hours** for this slot, so no side needs a compromise time.
- For 8 people, a fair approach is:
  - **25 minutes** for the most important shared topic
  - **20 minutes** for the second priority topic
  - **20 minutes** for updates and alignment
  - **15 minutes** for decisions and action items
  - **10 minutes** reserved as a buffer at the end

### Calendar invite description
**Title:** Remote Team Meeting — 2026-02-12

**Description:**
Objectives:
- Align on current priorities and blockers
- Make decisions on key open items
- Confirm owners, deadlines, and next steps
- Leave with a clear action list for the following week

Prep work:
- Review any pre-read or shared notes before the meeting
- Come ready with a 1-minute status update
- Flag blockers, decisions needed, and dependencies in advance
- Add any agenda items that need group attention

Agenda:
- 14:00–14:10 UTC — Welcome, goals, and agenda check
- 14:10–14:30 UTC — Team updates
- 14:30–14:55 UTC — Core discussion 1
- 14:55–15:15 UTC — Core discussion 2
- 15:15–15:20 UTC — Decisions and action items
- 15:20–15:30 UTC — Buffer, questions, and close

Note:
- A **10-minute buffer** is included at the end to absorb overruns and allow a clean close.

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Add to Calendar] https://calendar.google.com/
Action: [Button: Share Invite] https://outlook.live.com/calendar/
